evidence.excerpt: Compared to agentic chunking with frontier LLMs, D-RAC reduces chunking-stage output tokens by 95.7%, cutting chunking cost by 77.8% (GPT-4.1 pricing) to 85.6% (Gemini 2.5 Pro pricing) and chunking time by 75%.
